description: Check a claim about a live page. `must_contain`, `must_not_contain` and `expect_status` are checked exactly. A free-text `expectation` is judged from the page's text on paid keys; on other keys, or when the text can't settle it (how a page looks, what a click does), the verdict is `unverified` and you get the evidence to decide yourself. `pass` means everything asked was checked and held; `fail` means something checked did not.

expect_status.description: exact HTTP status expected; otherwise any answer under 400 counts as reachable

expectation.description: what should be true, in plain words

must_not_contain.description: text that must not appear (ignores case)

name: verify
title: Verify a claim
